slug: 2024-11-21 Over 17,400 South Sudanese receive national identity cards thanks to UNHCR and the EU

systems.system: National Identity Card issuance (EU/UNHCR joint project)
systems.owner: Directorate of Civil Registry, Nationality, Passport, and Immigration (DCRNPI), supported by UNHCR and the EU
systems.tiers: Central Equatoria: Morobo, Lainya, Yei and Kajo-Keji counties; project also in Torit and Wau

note: Identity-card issuance drive for returnees (17,400 cards in 2024); nothing on how births or deaths are registered.
